mentions.name: Coro
mentions.description: An open source auth management platform for NATS, designed as a self-hosted alternative to Synadia Cloud's BYON feature. Ships as a single Go binary with an embedded Svelte UI.
mentions.problem: NATS auth management was tied to a cloud offering (Synadia Cloud's BYON feature) without a self-hosted, open source alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on https://github.com/coro-sh/coro, which is an auth management platform for NATS.

The goal is basically to be a self hosted, open source alternative to Synadia Cloud’s BYON feature.

The whole project is shipped as a single Go binary with an embedded UI developed with Svelte.
